verdicts.reason: Both are the same sound left-to-right banner, but both share the same flaws: the '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk to an unreadable dot, and the VOLTSTRIDE box is jammed against the bottom-left edge. In A the body copy has a little more room between it and the CTA. In B the body copy nearly touches the 'Shop the Archive' button and the box crowds the green panel's edge, so B looks slightly more cramped.
